# GeoIP test fixtures

**These are not GeoLite2 databases.** Despite the names, they are MaxMind's
synthetic test fixtures — each one says so in its own metadata:

```
GeoLite2 Country Test Database (fake GeoIP2 data, for example purposes only)
GeoLite2 ASN Test Database (fake GeoIP2 data, for example purposes only)
```

244 and 412 networks respectively, against roughly 700k in the real product.
They are generated by [`cmd/write-test-data`](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/main/cmd/write-test-data)
from JSON in [`source-data/`](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/main/source-data),
and exist so that code reading `.mmdb` files can be tested.

Copied verbatim from [maxmind/MaxMind-DB](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB),
lowercased so `findDB`'s case-sensitive `*country*.mmdb` / `*asn*.mmdb` globs
match them:

- `geolite2-country-test.mmdb` — `test-data/GeoLite2-Country-Test.mmdb`
- `geolite2-asn-test.mmdb` — `test-data/GeoLite2-ASN-Test.mmdb`

The production databases an operator actually installs (see `docs/deploy.md`)
are a different thing entirely, covered by MaxMind's or DB-IP's own terms, and
are never committed here.
